summary: FM radio tuner where static thins out near a station, a waveform appears and the name resolves on lock; release nearby springs onto it.

events.name: lock
events.description: Fires each time the dial locks onto a station, with its name and frequency in MHz.

keyboard.action: Tune down or up by 0.1 MHz, then spring onto a station within 0.6 MHz.
Jump to the next or previous station, wrapping around.

accessibility: The canvas is focusable with `role="slider"`, `aria-label="Radio frequency"`, `aria-valuemin="87.5"` and `aria-valuemax="108"`.
`aria-valuenow` is the frequency; `aria-valuetext` adds the station name when locked, for example "101.1 MHz, Opus FM".
The status text ("Searching…" or "Locked · <station>") is an `aria-live="polite"` region.
motion: With reduced motion, the dial jumps onto a station instead of springing, the static stops flickering and the waveform holds still.
notes: The stations are built-in demo data: 89.3 LOFI BEATS, 94.7 NEWS 24, 101.1 OPUS FM and 105.5 DEEP CUTS. The band runs from 87.5 to 108 MHz and the dial starts at 97.6.
No audio plays. The host has a `data-locked` attribute while a station is locked; the station name fades in on the screen in the page font.
The canvas is 176px tall and animates continuously while on screen, except under reduced motion.

data.note: The four radio stations are invented; nothing can be set.
